meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 它把你的一份多步 DAG 定义存成 JSON 文件放进库目录,之后按名字重新运行,不必每次粘贴定义。加载时会自动轮换 key,并填充 {{key}}、{{date}}、{{datetime}} 等占位符。
howto.when: 当你想保存一份 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或反复调度同一张多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 把当前这张图保存成 nightly-audit,然后跑一次确认
用 nightly-audit 这个名字重新跑一遍
say.note: 默认轮换 key,每次都是全新一次运行
同后缀视为同一逻辑运行,可幂等恢复

howto.what_en: It stores a DAG definition as a JSON file in the library dirs and re-runs it by name, so you don't paste the definition each time. On load it rotates the key and fills placeholders such as {{key}} and {{date}}.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

say_en.text: Save the current graph as nightly-audit, then run it once to confirm

say_en.note: Default rotates the key, so it is a fresh run
Same suffix reuses the run idempotently
